target.statement: Open-MAGVIT2-I-In1k achieves rFID 1.17 on ImageNet 256x256 reconstruction (16x16 tokens, codebook 262144)

compute.basis: The target is a reconstruction metric from a released pretrained tokenizer; reproducing it requires downloading the model and ImageNet validation set, then running inference on 50k images, which is feasible on CPU but faster on GPU.

title: Open-MAGVIT2: An Open-Source Project Toward Democratizing Auto-regressive Visual Generation
